reason: E2 directly supports all key premises by reporting that Y/Hf co-doped NiCoCrAl MPEA achieves 59% lower TGO growth and negligible spallation at 1200°C due to rapid Al2O3 formation, lattice distortion elevating vacancy formation energy and Al migration barriers, and suppressed diffusion. E1 provides general background on oxidation thermodynamics but does not specifically support the claimed mechanism. The cited evidence is accurately represented and fully supports the hypothesis.
premises: Rapid selective oxidation of Al forms a protective Al2O3 scale in NiCoCrAl alloys.
Y and Hf co-doping induces lattice distortion in the Al-depletion zone.
Lattice distortion raises vacancy formation energy and Al migration barriers.
Suppressed Al diffusion retards oxide scale growth and spallation.
The mechanism operates at ~1200°C under cyclic oxidation.
